svg.text: Maritime Search and Rescue (SAR) · As-Is · notional · DoDAF 2.02 Capability Viewpoint
Detect, locate and rescue people in distress at sea; deliver them to care
Mission capabilities, in the order of a rescue: alert → coordinate → search → rescue → treat
Support all of C1 to C5
IDs encode the parent: C2.1 is part of C2. Colours are reused in the CV-4.
